audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Jayce 6 of 7 stages while Malphite wins 55.81% over 3641 games — the largest sample in this champion's whole table. The content prose flatly contradicts the chart it sits next to: 'From first item on this is mine', whys[5] 'your armor-stacking spike makes... out-trade his fragile hammer form', whys[6] 'delete him on engage' — yet win[5] and win[6] both say Jayce.
audit.why: Levels 1-5 really are Jayce's: Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate gains missile speed, range and damage, and Malphite has no answer to that range. But once armour is stacked and Malphite can close, a squishy hammer-form Jayce loses, which is what a 55.81% win rate over 3641 games reflects.
audit.corrected: First item and 2+ items should read Malphite. Blocked from proposing as an edit — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes carry no cooldowns, and the biggest spike in Jayce's kit — the stance-swap ultimate — is never mentioned in either layer.
audit.why: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer is a 6s swap, and the FIRST attack after swapping to cannon form reduces the target's Armor AND Magic Resist. Against Malphite that is not incidental: armour is both his survivability and his damage, since Ground Slam scales off it. Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s and Thundering Blow 20/18/16/14/12/10s, so his poke tightens dramatically as he ranks Q.
audit.corrected: Mercury Cannon's resistance reduction added as the reason his burst beats your armour maths, with the Shock Blast and Thundering Blow numbers.
sources: champ-data/_kits/jayce.json (R: 'first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist')

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to 'bait his E-knockback, then commit when it's down' — treating Thundering Blow as something that stops your engage. It does not stop the engage it is being baited for.
audit.why: Thundering Blow knocks the target back, and Unstoppable Force dashes with displacement immunity — the League Wiki ability note states the dash 'cannot be deterred by crowd control'. So his knockback cannot interrupt an airborne R. It only matters BEFORE the cast, or afterwards to shove you back off him once you have landed. That inverts the advice: you do not need to wait out a 20s cooldown to press R, you need to respect it for the follow-up.
audit.corrected: Both layers now say the knockback beats the cast and the follow-up, never the airborne dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Shock Blast' appears throughout the full layer with no number attached.
audit.why: Shock Blast runs 16/14/12/10/8/6s across six ranks — a 16s window at rank 1 that collapses to 6s when maxed, so the early advice ('wait out his poke') stops being true later in the lane and the page never signals that shift.
audit.corrected: The rank-1 16s versus maxed 6s spread is now stated so the commit window is decidable at both ends of the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization carries the unfilled template parenthetical '(by his AD profile)'.
audit.why: Jayce's damage is physical, so armour and Plated Steelcaps are correct. What the line misses is that Mercury Cannon's first attack strips armour and MR, so raw stacking is partially undone on his opener — Ground Slam's damage dips with it. This is worth stating rather than just naming items.
audit.corrected: Armour core kept; the Mercury Cannon strip named as the reason the first hit of his combo hurts more than the armour number suggests.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer ever uses Jayce's real ability names — everything is 'his cannon-stance Q', 'the acceleration gate', 'E-knockback'. Packet flagged 'Ground Slam's' in whys[3] as a suspect name, which is a false positive.
audit.why: Real names: Hextech Capacitor, To the Skies! / Shock Blast, Lightning Field / Hyper Charge, Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer. Ground Slam is correctly Malphite's E and needed no change.
audit.corrected: Real names used in the edited strings; Ground Slam left alone.

edits.before: From first item on this is mine. My job is to land R, not to chase: bait his E-knockback, then commit when it's down. I win every fight where I connect, so close the side lane and bring my game-winning engage to teamfights where his poke can't kite a five-man knock-up.

Don't wait out Thundering Blow to press R; it can't deter the dash. Bring the engage to teamfights, where his poke can't kite a five-man knock-up.
